additions.distinctness_review: No KCCS/ZED identity matches among 409 sites, 434 projects and 231 imported source records. The matched property is separate from Renewable Energy DC No.1 across the southwest road network and Sakura farther south. Locator distances are approximately 227 m and 312 m respectively; distances alone do not establish identity or boundary separation.

locator.identity_review: Official KCCS and Taisei sources identify the campus and designer. The architect-associated site plan and primary west-exterior photo match the five roof boxes, irregular southwest box, landscaped wedge, entrance and two parking areas in the georeferenced image. Root and an independent reviewer inspected the match and replayed the pixel-center calculation; the plan north arrow requires counterclockwise rotation before comparison.
locator.precision: Approximate analyst-selected point on the interior of the identified ZED Ishikari main building, used only as a parent-campus marker and rounded to four decimals. It is not an operator-published pin, surveyed centroid, building footprint, legal boundary or tenant/phase marker.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Image acquisition date and absolute geolocation accuracy are unestablished. Roof parallax, plan-to-built differences and manual identification introduce unquantified uncertainty; display resolution and coordinate decimal places are not ground accuracy.
